subject: Reignite: Acme Retail trial setup & next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmeretail.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Reignite: Acme Retail trial setup & next steps

Hi Jared / Lina —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum for the 14-day trial: 

1) What we demo'd: real-time product recommendation scoring using your last 30 days of catalog + session traces (cold-start handled by similarity embedding fallback).
2) What you agreed to validate: end-to-end latency for 99th pctl under typical traffic (500 qps burst), and inference cost per 1k requests.
3) Immediate action items (owners & timing):
   - Acme: share sample catalog export (CSV) and a short list of 10 test SKUs — due Tue 11/17 (Jared)
   - Redwood SE: seed a trial model and provide a short runbook for integration (Dev Patel) — I'll ask Dev to schedule that for Wednesday 11/18
   - Redwood CS: add success criteria and weekly check-in cadence to the MAP (Marissa)

Attachments: acme-mutual-action-plan.pdf (MAP), kickoff-zoom-invite.ics

Availability: If the 11/18 slot doesn't work for your engineering lead, propose an alternate window and we'll adjust. If you'd prefer, Dev can run a 45-minute office-hours session where we pair on the integration rather than walking through slides.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for LLMs
From: Jared Cole <jared.cole@acmeretail.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reignite: Acme Retail trial setup & next steps

Thanks, Evelyn — appreciate the clear notes. I’ll pull together the catalog extract and ping you by EOD Tuesday.

One ask: procurement may need estimated monthly cost bands before we spin up dedicated trial instances — can you include a short cost snapshot we can show them? No need for final billing, just ballpark numbers for a 2-week POC at the expected throughput.

—Jared
Senior Product Manager, Acme Retail

If helpful, I can share a 2-row cost matrix (hosted vs. dedicated trial) with assumptions so your procurement team has something concise to review. We generally show unit token/req assumptions, expected burst behavior, and a short note on credits for trial usage.

If plans changed and this is lower priority, let me know so we can pause scheduling and re-engage at a better time. Otherwise, Dev is ready to run the hands-on session as soon as you drop the sample files.

Evelyn / Dev — thanks for the follow up and for offering the office-hours approach. Heads up: we had an organizational shift this week and the engineering lead for personalization got pulled onto a critical outage response. Between that and a procurement freeze for a few vendor engagements, we won't have bandwidth to run the trial this month.

That said, the use case still maps to our roadmap and I want to keep things live. Can we tentatively rebook an onboarding session for the week of Jan 11? I’ll confirm by Dec 18 after I sync with procurement.

If you can, please send the short hosted vs dedicated 2-row cost matrix Jared requested earlier — procurement will want numbers during the review.

Appreciate the flexibility — will be in touch.

—Jared
